Interface MachineInstance

@NonExtendable public interface MachineInstance
A machine in the world (ARCHITECTURE.md §12). Owner thread only, except inspect() snapshots which are immutable once taken.

      @NotNull @NotNull Result<InstalledUpgrade> installUpgrade(@NotNull @NotNull UpgradeType type, int count)
      Installs count units of an upgrade.
      Returns:
      an error if the type is not accepted, the slots are full, or the stack limit is reached

    • upgradeRoom

      @NotNull @NotNull Result<Integer> upgradeRoom(@NotNull @NotNull UpgradeType type)
      How many more units of type the machine takes now.
      Returns:
      at least 1, or an error saying why none fit: not registered, not accepted, every upgrade slot used by other types, or already at UpgradeType.maxStack()

    • removeUpgrade

      int removeUpgrade(@NotNull @NotNull UpgradeType type, int count)
      Removes up to count units; returns how many were removed.

    • runAction

      @NotNull MachineAction.Outcome runAction(@NotNull @NotNull String id, @NotNull MachineAction.Click click)
      Runs one of the type's menu actions (D40, MachineType.action(String)). Owner thread. An unknown id, a machine no longer valid, or an action that throws is refused; a run that did something posts MachineEvents.ACTION.

    • list

      @NotNull @NotNull List<Map<String,String>> list(@NotNull @NotNull String id)
      The rows of one of the type's lists (D40, MachineType.list(String)); empty for an unknown id.

      Signals an external event (owner thread). Wakes the machine if its state accepts it.
